researchPlan.objective: Identify and extract current fullstack engineering job openings at software companies based in India from public career portals.
researchPlan.title: Fullstack Engineering Opportunities in India

outputFields.name: company_name
outputFields.description: The name of the hiring company
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for company branding or header text

outputFields.name: job_title
outputFields.description: The specific title of the engineering role
outputFields.validationHint: Must contain keywords like Fullstack, Full-stack, or Full Stack
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for H1 or job header tags

outputFields.name: location
outputFields.description: The office location or remote status
outputFields.validationHint: Must be within India or listed as Remote
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for location metadata or job description text

outputFields.name: application_link
outputFields.description: Direct URL to the job application page
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a valid, reachable URL
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for 'Apply' or 'Submit' button href attributes

outputFields.name: source
outputFields.description: The platform or career site where the job was found
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a valid domain name
outputFields.extractionHint: Extract the root domain of the source page

searchQueries: "fullstack engineer" hiring India software company career
researchPlan.sourceStrategy: Prioritize open Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) like Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby as they provide direct, high-quality job data without requiring authentication.

validationRules.rule: Must be a direct link to the job posting
Must explicitly mention fullstack or full-stack
